definitions.gloss: fatality rate; death rate among those affected
definitions.explanation: The proportion of people who die among those who catch a disease or suffer a particular injury. A medical and public-health term, common in news about epidemics.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{致死率|ちしりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: This disease has a low fatality rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{治療法|ちりょうほう}→治療法：27941_chiryouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{致死率|ちしりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Advances in treatment have brought the fatality rate down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{致死率|ちしりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{若年層|じゃくねんそう}→若年層：20942_jakunensou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: The survey showed that the fatality rate among the elderly is higher than among younger people.

notes:
⟦{致死|ちし}→致死：10002_chishi⟧ (causing death) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, ratio). Counts deaths only among people who actually contracted the disease, which is why the figure is often much larger than a mortality rate for the whole population.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {致死率|ちしりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have a high fatality rate
- {致死率|ちしりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to lower the fatality rate
- {致死率|ちしりつ}⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧: a fatality rate of one percent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{死亡率|しぼうりつ}→死亡率：25714_shibouritsu⟧: mortality rate — deaths measured against a whole population
- ⟦{感染率|かんせんりつ}→感染率：30144_kansenritsu⟧: infection rate — how many people catch the disease, not how many die
